name: Alice Lloyd College
academic_ranking: Small private four-year liberal arts college in Appalachian Kentucky (founded 1923). Known for its character-based, leadership-centered education and required Student Work Program; enrolls roughly 600 students, primarily from the Central Appalachian region.
financial_aid: Alice Lloyd College operates a Tuition Guarantee: residents of 108 Central Appalachian counties who are admitted pay $0 out-of-pocket tuition regardless of income, funded by the College's endowment and donor support. All students participate in the mandatory Student Work Program to help offset costs. Standard federal aid (FAFSA/Pell), scholarships and awards, and a Net Price Calculator are also available. No published USD sticker-tuition figure was found on the official site (alc.edu, checked 2026-07).
facilities_notes: Softball is one of the varsity sports listed on the Alice Lloyd College (Eagles) athletics site. No dedicated softball facility description (field name/complex details) was published on the pages checked; the athletics facilities page was not available (2026-07).
program_reputation: NAIA women's softball program at Alice Lloyd College (Eagles). The program has recent national recognition: a 2026 NAIA Softball All-American selection (Rife) was noted as a school-first honor on the athletics homepage.
